caption: The drawing depicts a garment, specifically a child’s dress or tunic, viewed from the back. The main object is a short-sleeved garment with a flared skirt, featuring four buttons along the back closure. The fabric has a brown background patterned with small, repeating white shapes forming a symmetrical design. The edges of the garment, including the sleeves, neckline, and hem, are outlined with a pinkish-red trim. The garment includes gathered sections at the waist, creating fullness in the skirt portion. Above the colored rendering, there is a simple, sketched outline of the same garment showing its basic shape and construction without any color or pattern detail. The beige background remains plain, with the artist's signature “E. GAUSSER” located in the lower right corner of the page.
title: Girl's Pinafore
